earned_by.reason: The valid screen's p50 and p95 clear reserve while 53 ticks set a p99 miss; eight slow events recur at 250/251-tick spacing and 35 fall in one cluster. Current X5 isolation still permits CPU7 timer, RCU, and kernel-worker work, but the old raw stream lacks thread CPU time and cannot attribute the slow ticks.

nomenclature.description: This is a zero-selection-weight T247 deployment timing diagnostic, not a T248/T250/T251 policy.

screen.host: unchanged calibrated T247 host with already-derived lower-cond0 route variant
screen.timing_population: locomotion stage calls at absolute ticks 250:2297
screen.stage_thread_cpu_ns: thread_cpu_end minus thread_cpu_start; includes only the current thread's scheduled CPU time plus paired clock-call overhead
screen.rusage_population: RUSAGE_THREAD sampled immediately outside the paired clock bracket
screen.system_counter_population: CPU7 /proc/softirqs and /proc/interrupts snapshots immediately before and after the paced chain
screen.slow_tick_reference_provenance: unchanged deployment-host reserve, used only to define an attribution subset; this diagnostic cannot pass the reserve

classification_rule.kernel_or_scheduler_dominant: stage wall p99 > 1.8 ms, stage thread CPU p99 <= 1.8 ms, and at least 80 percent of wall-slow ticks are not thread-slow
classification_rule.scheduled_compute_dominant: stage thread CPU p99 > 1.8 ms and at least 80 percent of wall-slow ticks are also thread-slow
classification_rule.mixed: neither dominance rule holds while at least one wall-slow tick exists
classification_rule.no_current_slow_population: no wall-slow tick exists; report but do not reopen the closed reserve screen
classification_rule.context_switch_and_fault_counters: secondary attribution only; they cannot override the paired-clock classification

forbidden_changes: T247, calibrator, route variant, policy ABI, observation, action, recurrence, phase, P30, target, offsets, or rate checks
boot parameters, IRQ affinity, workqueue affinity, kernel tunables, or governor except the existing temporary performance wrapper
serial, GPIO, I2C, controllers, sensors, servos, torque, or motion
a second attribution execution, a reserve re-score, or any threshold change

launch_contract.runner_launch: sudo -n env OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 taskset -c 7 chrt -f 80 <sealed invocation>
